pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ zài kàn diànyǐng.
english: I will watch a movie again this afternoon.

hanzi: 他没有时间，明天再告诉我。
pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gàosu wǒ.
english: He has no time; he will tell me tomorrow.

hanzi: 我想让她看看这件白衣服。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng ràng tā kànkan zhè jiàn bái yīfu.
english: I want to let her take a look at this white piece of clothing.

pinyin: Tā zài zhǎo tā de shū.
english: He is looking for his book.

pinyin: Wǒ děng yíxià gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
english: I will wait a moment and call you.

pinyin: Fúwùyuán, zhè jiàn yīfu bú guì.
english: Waiter, this piece of clothing is not expensive.

hanzi: 她喜欢白的，不喜欢黑的。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan bái de, bù xǐhuan hēi de.
english: She likes the white one, not the black one.

pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shìqing xiǎng gàosu nǐ.
english: I have something I want to tell you.
